tokens.name: plate
tokens.usage: Page background, the baseplate every step sits on. Carries the stud texture; `ink` and `muted` read on it.

tokens.name: plateDot
tokens.usage: The studs of the stud texture on `plate`. A background texture: no contrast requirement, and keep it faint (about 1.1:1 on `plate` in both themes). Never text.

tokens.name: tray
tokens.usage: Working surfaces: the app bar, the tools column, panels, lists, the phone tool bar.

tokens.name: groove
tokens.usage: Every border and divider: Tray edges, section rules, toggle outlines. Light 1.7:1 on `tray` (as the app ships, below the 3:1 a control border needs); dark 2.4:1.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Text and headings on `tray`, `plate` and `azureWash` (light 13:1+, dark 12:1+).

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Help text, status lines, Info labels and unselected tool-bar items, on `tray` and `plate` (light 6.1:1 and 4.7:1, dark 6.5:1 and 7.4:1).

tokens.name: azure
tokens.usage: The one accent: contained buttons, the current step, the selected tool, links and the focus ring. Text in `azure` on `tray`: light 5.1:1, dark 6.2:1. In dark it is light enough to take dark text, so fills use `on-azure`.

tokens.name: azureDark
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of `azure` fills. In dark it is the lighter step, so hover still moves away from the ground.

tokens.name: azureWash
tokens.usage: Selected toggle and row backgrounds; `ink` or `azure` text sits on it.

tokens.name: on-azure
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `azure` and `azureDark` fills (the contained button, the current step number): white in light, near-black in dark (7.2:1).

tokens.name: azure-outline
tokens.usage: Border of an outlined button (MUI: primary at 50%).

tokens.name: icon
tokens.usage: Icon buttons (the ☰ menu) and unselected toggle text: MUI action.active.

tokens.name: disabled
tokens.usage: Text of disabled controls and of the steps that wait for an image. Decorative only: it does not meet 4.5:1, by design.

tokens.name: disabled-fill
tokens.usage: Fill of a disabled contained button.

tokens.name: swatch-edge
tokens.usage: The 1px inset edge of a ColorSwatch, so white bricks show on `tray` and black ones on the dark `tray`. Never a solid black border.

tokens.name: toast-action
tokens.usage: A text action on a toast ("Undo"): 8.9:1 on the light toast (`ink`), 5.9:1 on the dark one.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors only: the error toast's fill. Never decoration, never a second accent. Always with an icon and words, never colour alone.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text and icon on `danger` (light 6.5:1, dark 7.9:1).

color.note: Two themes with the same roles: a light and a dark baseplate.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Large headings: dialogs and the empty-state card ("Start with a picture").

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: The step name in the phone app bar.

styles.name: subtitle1
styles.usage: Tool group titles (ControlSection) and summary values.

styles.name: body2
styles.sample: 12 cards on 2 pages, 8 per A4 landscape page.
styles.usage: Help text under a control, status lines, Info rows; in `muted`.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Every button and step tab; sentence case, never uppercase.

styles.name: button-large
styles.usage: A large contained button: the one button in an empty state.

styles.name: swatch-id
styles.usage: The BrickLink colour id on a ColorSwatch: weight 500, tabular figures, black or white by the brick colour.

styles.name: toolbar-label
styles.usage: Labels in the phone tool bar; 500 when selected.

styles.name: step-number
styles.usage: The number in a step tab's circle.

spacing.note: MUI spacing units of 8 px. 2 (16 px) between zones and groups, 1–1.5 inside a group.

tokens.name: space-0.75
tokens.usage: Label to control in a ChoiceRow; rows of an InfoList.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Phone page gutter; gap between swatches.

tokens.name: space-1.5
tokens.usage: Between settings inside a group; Stage padding on phones.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between zones and groups; Tray and ControlSection padding.

tokens.name: space-2.5
tokens.usage: Above and below the button in the empty-state card.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Stage padding from 600 px up.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Column gap between MosaicSummary facts; padding inside the empty-state card.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Buttons, toggles, inputs (the theme's shape.borderRadius).

tokens.name: radius-tray
tokens.usage: Tray: the tools column and other working surfaces.

tokens.name: radius-panel
tokens.usage: Top corners of the phone tool panel.

tokens.name: radius-stage
tokens.usage: Stage, the canvas holder (no fill, so it shows only in focus outlines).

tokens.name: radius-swatch
tokens.usage: ColorSwatch: a rounded square like the mark, a step tighter than `radius-control` at its smaller size.

shadow.note: Panels and trays have no shadow. Only what floats over the canvas has one: the phone tool panel (`shadow-panel`), toasts and the zoom control (`shadow-float`).

tokens.name: shadow-none
tokens.usage: Tray, Paper, buttons (disableElevation).

tokens.name: shadow-panel
tokens.usage: The phone tool panel over the canvas (MUI elevation 8).

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Small things that float over the canvas: a toast, the zoom control (MUI elevation 2).

tokens.name: tap-target
tokens.usage: Minimum height (and toggle width) of every button and toggle.

tokens.name: swatch-width
tokens.usage: ColorSwatch width: fits a three-digit BrickLink id.

tokens.name: swatch-height
tokens.usage: A display ColorSwatch (tables, menus, the map page).

tokens.name: swatch-control-height
tokens.usage: A ColorSwatch you click, with a fine pointer: dense enough for a 68-colour palette, above the 24px WCAG minimum.

tokens.name: swatch-touch-width
tokens.usage: A ColorSwatch you tap on a touch screen: 44 × `tap-target`.

tokens.name: tools-column
tokens.usage: Width of the desktop tools column.

tokens.name: app-bar
tokens.usage: Desktop app bar height; the tools column sticks under it.

tokens.name: tool-bar
tokens.usage: Phone tool bar height (52px per row when it has two).

tokens.name: breakpoint-desktop
tokens.usage: From here the tools become the left column and the steps sit in the app bar.

tokens.name: stud-pitch
tokens.usage: Spacing of the stud texture; each stud is a 3px-radius dot.

tokens.name: empty-card
tokens.usage: Width of the empty-state card.

tokens.name: icon-button
tokens.usage: The ☰ menu button: an MUI IconButton, 44px square.

tokens.name: toast-max
tokens.usage: Widest a toast grows; on a phone it is the screen less `space-2` each side.

tokens.name: canvas-inset
tokens.usage: How far the zoom control sits from the canvas box's bottom and right edges, clear of the scroll bars.

tokens.name: zoom-readout
tokens.usage: Width of the zoom control's percentage, so the buttons don't move as it changes.
